risks.title: Breaking-change-detector class may need refactor
risks.mitigation: If compareSignatures cannot be exposed as a private method pattern, add as instance method delegating to module-level function

risks.title: helpers.ts vitest config fix may break include pattern for other files
risks.mitigation: Use vitest exclude pattern specifically for helpers.ts rather than global include

risks.title: Route detection count changes may indicate real scanner behavioral change
risks.mitigation: Verify actual route count by reading fixture file — update assertions to match actual scanner output if behavior is correct

risks.title: indexing-orchestrator stale check happens before sourceDir is read
risks.mitigation: Mock or spy on the stale-check method in the test; or pass a custom project root that has no .coderef/graph.json

decision_records.decision: Fix breaking-change-detector by adding private instance methods to BreakingChangeDetector class that delegate to module-level functions
decision_records.rationale: Test uses detector['compareSignatures'] — the modular refactor broke this. Adding private methods to the class preserves the test pattern without requiring large test rewrites.

decision_records.decision: Fix helpers.ts vitest issue via vitest.config.ts exclude, not by renaming the file
decision_records.rationale: helpers.ts has no describe/test blocks so vitest fails with 'No test suite found'. Adding it to exclude list is the minimal fix.

decision_records.decision: Fix generator test assertions that fail due to helpers.ts having 4 elements not 3
decision_records.rationale: The listen element was added to createMockEnvironment() but totalElements assertions were not updated.

decision_records.decision: Skip cloud-service mock tests via vitest.skip (test.skip in test file), not vitest.config exclude
decision_records.rationale: Dispatch specifies vitest skip annotation; this preserves test existence while skipping network-dependent tests.
